notes.subject: מנעליך
notes.rationale: 'I ka da-bolonw' (bolts of your gate) versus KJV/Wycliffe 'shoes' — ancient versions differ: bars/bolts vs sandals.

notes.subject: דבאך
notes.rationale: דֹבֶא appears only here; rendered 'sebagaw' (strength), glossed 'quiet' — sense uncertain.

notes.subject: to Asher
notes.rationale: Blessing addressed directly to the tribe of Asher (Ashɛri).

translation: Nɛgɛ ni kɔbi ye i ka da-bolonw ye; i ka donw bɛ cogo min na, i ka sebagaw bɛna kɛ o cogo na.

tokens.gloss: i ka donw bɛ cogo min na
